generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of kppp portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Department Registration Details
Total value of Electrical works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details

As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
Royalty on Civil materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Government orders.
GST will be paid to tendered amount Separately.
To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer should furnish qualification information as per section 3 of Standard Tender Document attached to this tender KW-1.
All the Formats prescribed in the bid documents shall be filled in complete manner.
The Tenderer should maintain the Work during defective liability period of 1 year.

The materials required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should be got feasibility report from the Polytechnic/Engineering/Quality Control Authorities before use on the work.
Work done certificate should be issued by competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer (Ele).

The item rates quoted shall include cost of royalty charges on construction materials & other taxes as per the rates provided in prevailing cost & conveyance of all materials, Curing, Watering, unloading with all leads & lifts labour, hire charges of machinery equipments etc., complete including all incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer in charge of the work.

To qualify for award of contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last Five years i.e. From 2021-22 to 2025-26 (a) achieved in at least two financial years an average financial turnover (Usually not less than the two times the estimated annual payments under this contract) Submit the scanned copy of the Profit & loss Statement indicating the contract receipts certified by the chartered accountant with valid UDIN number.

The Security deposit (including additional security for unbalanced tenders) shall be provided to the Employer no later than the date specified in the Letter of Acceptance and shall be issued in an amount and form and type of instrument acceptable to the Employer. The Security deposit shall be valid until a date 30 days from the date of expiry of Defects Liability Period and the additional security for unbalanced tenders shall be valid until a date 30 days from the date of issue of the certificate of completion.
The tenderer should be a class-I Electrical contractor issued by the Competent Authority.
The Contractor should submit the Aadhar, PAN, GST Registration Copy.

All Scanned Documents of the Original should be up-loaded, Executive Engineer reserves the rights to verify the Original Documents before approval, 0riginal documents / Certificates for qualification shall be produced when called for during evaluation of tender.

To qualify for Award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last Five years i.e. From 2021-22 to 2025-26 satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one similar work value not less than 50% of the amount put to tender. (Scanned copy of the Work done Certificate issued by competent Authority of rank not less than Executive Engineer should be uploaded.)

Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than (Credit lines/ Letters of Credit/ Certificates form Banks) for meeting the fund requirement etc., (usually 30% of the amount of contract)
Further details of work can be obtained from the office of the under signed on all working days up to 5.30pm.
All terms and Conditions as per Standard tender documents KW-1.
Value at present price level, of existing commitments and ongoing works documents to be submitted.
Within 10 days of the receipt of the Letter of acceptance the successful tenderer shall deliver to the employer a security deposit.
The successful tenderer shall pay Security Deposit in value equivalent to 5 percent of the entrusted amount of work in the form of e-Bank Guarantee at the time of agreement.
The terms & conditions laid down in KTTP Act 1999 & rules 2000 with subsequent amendments are applicable.

The Executive Engineer, K.S.D.B., Shivamogga Division, Shivamogga reserves all the rights to accept/ Reject any or/all Tenders and to cancel the tender process at any stage prior to award of the contract without assigning any reason.

If the Tenderer fails to start the work within the scheduled time period after the issue of Work Order, Executive Engineer holds the right to forfeit the FSD and the Tender Difference amount submitted.

The tenderer should visit the proposed constructions site & submit the report regarding men, material & completion of works to the concerned AEE, Shivamogga sub division, Shivamogga & should compulsorily upload the letter issued by Assistant Executive Engineer, K.S.D.B., Shivamogga Sub-Division, Shivamogga addressed to the Executive Engineer, K.S.D.B., Shivamoggg Division, Shivamogga along with the technical bid. (Feasibility Certificate)
Tenderer should upload scanned face sheet of ITR for the block period 2021-22 to 2025-26 compulsorily.
Materials of ISI quality and the company-specified design shall be used in the work.
After completion of the work, all electrical materials shall be handed over to the company free of cost.
The warranty for the materials used in the work shall be provided for one year after handing over the line, and for 5 years for the transformer and U.G. cable.
Purchase records of the materials shall be provided.
The work shall be carried out under the supervision of a MESCOM officer, and if any accident occurs in the work, the Board/Municipal Corporation/Company shall not be responsible.
The materials used in the work shall be inspected by the competent authorities and installed only after approval.
The removed materials shall be returned to the Shivamogga Regional Warehouse.

Warning signboards visible to the public/various types of vehicle users shall be compulsorily installed at the work site, and before commencing the work, the Assistant Executive Engineers (Electrical) and Junior/Assistant (Electrical) Engineers of the respective ward of the Municipal Corporation shall be informed, and only then the work shall be started.
The work shall be carried out safely as per Electrical Safety Dos & Donts.

After the electrical work is brought into operation, necessary steps shall be taken to register the electricity meter in the name of The Commissioner, Municipal Corporation, Shivamogga for payment of the electricity bill.
The street lights (LED) installed in the work shall be maintained for two years.
Install and maintain the materials used in the work as per the Specification.
